verified: Production native helper and Apps policy identify a temporary toy application and accessible text field.
Stable reference click and real synthetic typing reach only the fixture app and exact expected window.
Independent AppKit field-editor reads and agent Accessibility observations agree on typed content.
Owner pause and the server phone-control flag prevent subsequent input; resuming permits replacement text.
Revocation stops later input and preserves the last confirmed field value.
An Apple-signed WindowServer cursor at the exact cursor layer no longer blocks the underlying allowed app.
Plain text events clear modifiers inherited from Command+A, avoiding accidental shortcut execution.
limitations: This is a deterministic tool/API workflow; no model was in the loop.
Phone-control state was set through the server adapter; no physical phone was used.

The toy window uses status-bar window level 25 to remain above Notification Center and Dock surfaces. Ordinary-window overlap with those surfaces remains conservatively refused and is not resolved by the cursor-only fix.
No screenshot capture or real private app content was accessed.
The first-observation time includes cold compilation of the production helper in a fresh temporary directory; later timings are local only.
